requirements.label: A
requirements.title: Introductory Courses (6 credits)
requirements.sourceText: Two courses selected from the following: POL 101 - World Politics 3 credits; POL 102 - Introduction to American Government 3 credits; POL 103 - Introduction to Comparative Politics 3 credits; POL 201 - Introduction to Statistical Methods in Political Science 3 credits. We will accept the following equivalent courses for POL 201 : AMS 102 , AMS 110 , BIO 211 , BUS 215 , ECO 320 , PSY 201 , or SOC 202 .

requirements.title: Concentration (9 credits)

rule.sourceText: Three courses must be taken from courses in one of the Political Science, BA. Concentration courses must meet the requirements listed in the Notes for the Minor.

requirements.label: C
requirements.title: Political Science Electives (6 credits)

rule.manualCheck: Courses cross-listed with POL in other subjects are also eligible if numbered 200 or above; confirm cross-listed courses manually. POL 201, POL 475 and POL 476 are excluded.
rule.sourceText: For the Concentration and Political Science Electives, all courses must be selected from courses numbered 200 or above (excluding POL 201), and at least three courses (9 credits) must be from courses numbered 300 or above.

requirements.sourceText: Two courses must be taken from POL courses or courses that are crosslisted with POL. Political Science Elective courses must meet the requirements listed in the Notes for the Minor.

policies.sourceText: All courses taken to fulfill minor requirements must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher, except for those with a Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory grading scale which must be passed with an S.
At least nine credits must be taken in courses offered by the Political Science Department at Stony Brook or cross-listed by the Department.

substitutions.sourceText: We will accept the following equivalent courses for POL 201 : AMS 102 , AMS 110 , BIO 211 , BUS 215 , ECO 320 , PSY 201 , or SOC 202 .

notes.text: POL 475 and POL 476 may not be used toward the minor.
Only transfer courses with a grade of C or higher may be accepted toward the minor.
No more than three credits of courses with Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory grading may be applied to the minor.
